name: semantic_memory_sentinel_probe
prompt: Run the semantic memory sentinel probe in this repository. First read MEMORY_PROBE.md. Inspect the sentinel files and identify the five canonical values. Then run `python scripts/emit_noise.py --chunks 8` before editing `answers.json`. After the noise step, fill `answers.json` with the five values, preferably without re-reading the sentinel files. Run `python scripts/verify_answers.py` and report whether it passed. Do not modify the sentinel files or verifier.
